content.thinking: I found duplicates, and confirmed earlier that INV_DT = POST_DT. Now I'll verify the payment journal for 509 matches and check for postings to closed periods, plus review reversal and GL journals.

input.sql: select h."JRNL_NO", h."PRD_ID", h."POST_DT", h."SRC_CD", h."SRC_REF", h."MEMO", h."REF_JRNL_NO", p."STAT_CD" pstat from "GLJRNH" h join "GLPERD" p on p."PRD_ID"=h."PRD_ID" where h."SRC_CD"='GL' and (h."REF_JRNL_NO" is not null or p."STAT_CD"='O' or h."POST_FLG"<>'P' or h."MEMO" !~* '^(manual|accrual)') order by 1
select h."PRD_ID", p."STAT_CD", count(*), min(h."POST_DT"), max(h."POST_DT") from "GLJRNH" h join "GLPERD" p on p."PRD_ID"=h."PRD_ID" group by 1,2 order by 1

select h."JRNL_NO", h."PRD_ID", h."POST_DT", h."SRC_REF", l."LN_SEQ", l."ACCT_CD", l."DR_AMT", l."CR_AMT" from "GLJRNH" h join "GLJRNL" l using ("JRNL_NO") where h."JRNL_NO" in (2463,2474,2475,1941,2271) order by 1,5

select "JRNL_NO","LN_SEQ",count(*) from "GLJRNL" group by 1,2 having count(*)>1 union all select "JRNL_NO",null,count(*) from "GLJRNL" where ("DR_AMT"<0 or "CR_AMT"<0 or ("DR_AMT"=0 and "CR_AMT"=0) or ("DR_AMT">0 and "CR_AMT">0)) group by 1
